outcome.interpretation: The campaign had no indexed charter, and its capability projection exposed the generic session Work Intent without an explicit campaign objective. This is one observed context gap; it does not establish repeated agent confusion or adverse work outcomes.
outcome.analysis_limit: The finding comes from one campaign context. It does not establish that agents were unable to recover the user-directed objective from other sources or that the gap recurs across sessions.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Capability projection has no verified campaign objective when charter context is absent
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment campaign continuity and environmental-capability projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: One canonical campaign state returned no campaign charter reference, and one projection subject showed only the separate generic session Work Intent.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a campaign objective only from a unique content-addressed charter verified for the current campaign, and keep it distinct from the current session Work Intent.
not_measured: recurrence across independent sessions or campaigns
whether an agent was confused or delayed by the missing campaign objective
whether the campaign objective was available through another authoritative entry surface
availability of equivalent context through other entry mechanisms
